name: arrow-left
description: A left-facing navigation arrow with a straight shaft and open chevron head.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner explicitly requested larger native None glyphs while retaining the existing smaller Square/Circle glyphs unchanged. All eight Arrow None variants share an18.25-unit shaft and6.84375-unit head half-span at fixed Regular1.75, with20px visible physical length along the shaft. Rotate this single construction about12,12; diagonal arrows are never independently scaled to artboard edges. Filled analytically unites the fixed-radius.875 shaft and rounded solid triangular head. None geometry is authored separately from frames, with no runtime style/frame scaling and no scaling of stroke width. Rebuild all Filled contours at the fixed source stroke expansion; never scale a previous Filled path. Square/Circle SVG and metadata files retain their previous exact artwork and dimensions. This supersedes the older requirement that None and framed glyphs have identical size. Native X/Y100/100 and rotation0 remain the new None baseline. Revised None glyph awaits owner review; existing frame review status is unchanged.

review.note: Larger native None glyph requested by owner; smaller Square/Circle variants are preserved unchanged. Awaiting owner visual review.
